_comment: Connectors the plugin declares. Remote servers (atlassian, figma) are matched to an existing connection by URL; entries with an empty url are matched by NAME to the host's connector directory (first-party connectors whose endpoint is dynamic). Tableau is deliberately NOT declared — it is a local MCP server the user runs themselves (see README → Plugin components). Tool namespaces observed per server live in references/integration-strategy.md → Declared connectors. Empty-url entries are a Claude convention, kept deliberately: Codex CLI (0.153) does not match by name and fails them at session start — see integration-strategy.md §1a; they may start working there if Codex adopts the convention. Since v3.3.0 six OPTIONAL research connectors are declared (lazyweb, similarweb, mobbin, semrush, tavily, apify): URL-matched, each user connects their own account/key in the host; every skill works without them.
